en: Marching like a parade. But angrier.
I'll think of a joke on the way.

ru: Не ори в рацию. Я рядом.
en: Stop shouting on radio. I'm right here.
Forgot the parachute. Didn't need it.
On the ground. They're shooting already.
Got it. I'll take the zone.
Don't run. I'll reach you anyway.
You've got me confused with the radio.
I hear you, Cap. The whole channel does.

ru: Ещё щелчок — и я в отпуске.
en: One more click and I'm on leave.
Got it. Wrote it down. Tossed it.
The clouds can wait. You can't.
I bring confidence. Rest is yours.

ru: Что-то горит? Я как раз тут.
Кто там у нас без дела?

en: Make it quick. I'm hurrying to live.
You command. The rest is mine.
You called? Or was that wind?
I need a target. Preferably big.
I don't fight. I entertain the enemy.
Give me coffee and I'm yours.
If I fall, I'll land dramatically.

ru: Карта не нужна. Я чую путь.
en: No map needed. I feel the path.

ru: Всё по плану. Я в плане.
en: All to plan. I'm in the plan.
There? Fine. I'll walk it pretty.
Wind in my face. Love it.
I'll arrive. Then we'll make noise.

ru: Шагаю, как на парад. Без публики.
en: Marching like a parade. No audience.
I'd like wings. Or an elevator.
Going. If I return, you're buying.
I'd like a plane. Or lunch.
I'll get there. It's surely noisy.
Don't poke. Got enough trouble already.
As long as our own don't "help."
I'm here. Where would I go?
Listening. Can I finish my tea?

ru: Миротворец на месте. Мира не будет.

en: I'll get there. Walking or crawling.
Yeah, I got it, I got it.
Stop poking. This isn't a market.
Once more and I'm going for a smoke.
Used to being called at bad times.
Boots are dry. Already a win.
It's cold. Getting used to it.
Mud to the knee. No matter.
Had it quieter. Had it louder.
Of all evils, I picked you.

ru: Говори. Я всё равно не спал.

en: Thanks for not doing it at night.
Could tell you off. But I'm listening.
I'm an optimist. Just a grumpy one.
Command. I'll do it my way.
Say it's quiet. Lie to me.
Life is pain. But I'm listening.
Legs still carry me. For now.
Walking. The tea will go cold.
Anywhere. As long as it's warm.
Boots are wet. But they walk.
I'll get there. If I don't freeze.

ru: Иду, как на работу. Это работа.
en: Going like it's work. It is work.
If only rails. Or a taxi.
One-two. The rest is a surprise.
Walking's not running. Already a plus.

ru: Мне бы в отпуск. Но иду.

en: Worse than mud: only the brass.
Don't poke. Got enough trouble already.
As long as our own don't "help."
Give the orders. I'll handle it.
I'll get there. Not my first time.
I'll calm them down. For good.

ru: Ещё раз — и сама буду командовать.
en: Once more and I'll take command myself.
Main thing first. Then the rest.
Talk. I'll sort out the rest.

en: The cold is familiar. Mind clear.
Say it plainly. I'll do it plainly.
You command. I execute. For now.
I'm calm. That's the scary part.
Returned my nerves to the depot.
My voice is the best sedative.
Say it again. I'll test my patience.
I command softly. They obey loudly.
My smile is rare. I save it.

ru: Не трогай меня. Я ещё добрая.
en: Don't poke me. I'm still kind.
I'll go unhurried. Safer that way.
I know the way. Don't distract me.
I chose the route. Don't argue.
Cold and wind are no obstacle.
I'll go round the right. Stay clear.
Cover my back. The rest is mine.
Don't hurry. I'll be there first.
If I get lost, it's recon.

ru: Грязь любит меня. Я её нет.
en: Mud loves me. I don't love it.

en: I'd love a sleigh. Anything rolling.
The commander goes. So do the rest.
I'll come over. Not through gunfire.

en: You shoot. I'll handle the paperwork.

We'll come to terms. We always do.

ru: Перемещаюсь. Без спешки, но в срок.

en: Going. Put it in the report.
Allow me to close the matter.
Noting it. For the third time.

ru: Прошу без суеты. Мы же цивилизованы.
Галстук поправлю. И вернусь к вам.
en: I'll fix my tie and return.
A business approach is my style.
We'll discuss the agenda as we go.
Don't worry. We'll agree on all.
Brevity please. Time is an asset.
My time is costly. Yours too.
Best argument: politeness. And a barrel.
I'll send the bill later. Politely.

ru: Я не торгуюсь. Я предлагаю дважды.
en: I don't haggle. I offer twice.

ru: Рад вас видеть. Рад вас слышать.
en: Glad to see you. Glad to hear you.
Going. I'll send a report copy.
I'll approve the route as I go.
I'll arrive early. I like order.
I'll arrive and report. In writing.
Business trip, no per diem. Going.
If I'm late, geography's to blame.
I ask my legs to vote "yes".
A step forward is also a deal.
My bonus is out there. Going.
I'll file it all on site. Going.
I'll come over. Not through gunfire.

ru: Вы стреляйте. Я уже всё оформлю.
en: You shoot. I'll handle the paperwork.
Fine. But it goes on record.

ru: Ещё раз — и я подам жалобу.
en: Once more and I file a complaint.

ru: Документы при мне. Вопросы к вам.
en: Papers on me. Questions to you.
My desk's clear. So's my mind.
Allow me to finish my note.

ru: Я не злюсь. Я вежливо отмечаю.
en: I'm not angry. I politely note it.

ru: Мне платят за улыбку. Потрачу её.
en: I'm paid for smiling. I'll spend it.
I checked the route. No risks.
I'm not used to being late.
I'll write the report while walking.
I'll file my arrival in advance.
Allow me to pass. Politely asking.
Nice weather for a business trip.
Sorry for the shoes. Duty calls.
If I break a heel, you get the bill.
Moving closer. Don't lose the trail.

Мимо не пройду. И не промахнусь.
en: Won't pass him. Won't miss him.
In place. Still as a stump.
Got it. Won't snap a twig.
One shot. That's all it takes.
You're noisy. The game will bolt.
Quit clicking. Like a dry twig.
Once more and I'll track you down.
Forest is silent. So am I.
Wind in face. I hear well.
Grass is flattened. Someone was here.

ru: Мох на севере. Я на месте.
en: Moss to the north. I'm here.

ru: Не спеши. Зверь тоже не спешит.

en: I'm not quiet. Words are precious.
A hedgehog is louder than you.

ru: Волки со мной дружат. Ты нет.
en: Wolves like me. You, not so much.
If I vanish, look under a spruce.

ru: Меня зовут Тишина. Не зови громко.
en: My name is Silence. Don't call loud.
Forest is my friend. You're an acquaintance.
First I listen. Then I move.
I'll go by the forest edge.
I'll lie in grass. Crawl through.
Animals won't hear. Nor the enemy.
I'll go round through the ravine.
Quieter than a hare. But angrier.
I see the trail. Following it.
Where it's darker, there I am.

ru: Я в кустах. Ты не видел.
en: I'm in the bushes. You saw nothing.
Walking the trail. Greetings to game.
Moving closer. Don't lose the trail.

ru: Не шуми. Сам к нам выйдет.
Мимо не пройду. И не промахнусь.
en: Won't pass him. Won't miss him.

ru: Я его вижу. Он меня нет.
en: I see him. He doesn't see me.
Ready. Waiting for him to step out.
On the trail. Step by step.

ru: Ещё щелчок — и уйду в кусты.
en: One more click and I vanish.
I'm silent. But I see all.
Long shadows. Time for the patient.
The forest breathes. I'm with it.
First I watch. Then I speak.
Wiped the scope. And my eyes.
Calm. Like a lake before a storm.
A pause is a strategy too.
Few words. Each hits the mark.
Forest is the best listener. Never interrupts.
Caught a deer's eye. It understood.
You're loud as a cart. Sorry.
First I look. Then I go.
Going by the edge. Quieter there.
Round the hill. Out from the side.
The trail's narrow. Enough for me.
The forest will tell. I'll go.
I'll avoid dry twigs. All of them.

ru: Хожу, как рысь. Только без когтей.
en: Walking like a lynx. Minus claws.
If I crack a twig, it's a hedgehog.
I'm not sneaking. I'm just unseen.
I'll return quieter than I left.
Going. Noise was banned for me.

ru: Лицо попроще. Всё равно не поможет.
en: Lose the attitude. Won't help anyway.

ru: Я бы поговорил. Ты уже стреляешь.

en: What shall we show the crowd today?
A stroll. Like across a piazza.
One step and the stage is mine.
Lead on. I follow with honour.
Allow me to introduce myself. Finally.
I got it. Repeating is rude.
Once more and I'll sulk. Elegantly.
Matter of honour? Then I'm ready.
Curtain's up. What are we playing?
Glory waits. What do we do?
Pasta would be nice. Listening though.
If I break, put me in a museum.

ru: Спеть бы. Но враги не ценят.

en: Ah, what a shadow I have!
Not in the rain. My hair.
A walk. No fuss, but stylish.
With a light stride to victory.

ru: Как скажете. Лишь не в грязь.
en: As you say. Just not in mud.
Boots polished. Let's go in style.
Let the orchestra play. I'm off.

ru: Идём к славе. Или к ужину.

en: If I fall, I'll fall nicely.
Walking is art. I'm a master.
I'll arrive and sing. Be warned.
There? Is there coffee at least?
If anything, I was just strolling.

ru: Иду. Но с песней не обещаю.
Лицо попроще. Всё равно не поможет.
en: Lose the attitude. Won't help anyway.
Move him. Got on my boots.
I'll go. My heels can take it.
I hear you. I'm not deaf.

ru: Ещё раз — и останетесь без ужина.
en: Once more and no dinner for you.
Make it quick. I'm rushing to shine.
Let them praise the dress first.
Does this role suit me? Speak.
Listening. May I hold my glass?
Expecting me? Of course you were.
I'd have a drink. But I'm listening.
Don't stare like that. I know.
You can't have the dress. Speak.
Let me finish my drink. Joking.
Don't crease the dress, and I'll go.
Going. Let the orchestra catch up.
If the path is muddy, carry me.
Going. Take pictures while you can.
I walk. The rest are spectators.
Freeze. Should be easy for you.

ru: Не подгоняй. Тут и так скользко.
en: Don't rush me. Slippery enough here.
Warm up when the shooting stops.

ru: Я в порядке. Только борода замёрзла.
en: I'm fine. Just a frozen beard.

ru: В следующий раз беру тёплый магазин.

en: What? Just not into the wind.
Fine. I'll warm up at least.
I'll make it. Not my first time.
Hold still. Too cold to wait.
I'm not frozen solid. I hear you.
Once more and into the snowdrift.
Frost on my brows. Still listening.
Can't feel my nose. Still listening.
Boots are dry. What's the task?
I see my breath. So I'm alive.
The service is cold. I'm used to it.
Winter's long. Is the order short?

ru: Чаю бы горячего. Хоть бы чаю.
en: Hot tea would be nice. Any tea.
Mama said keep your hat on.

ru: Стряхни с меня снег. Потом говори.
en: Brush off my snow. Then talk.
Snowdrifts are deeper than your orders.

ru: Иней на всём. Даже на мне.

en: Only my left elbow feels anything.

ru: Не спеши. Мороз сам не уйдёт.
en: Don't rush. Frost won't leave itself.
Snow squeaks. So all is well.
Going. Ice crunches, so it's solid.

ru: Шаг за шагом. Сугроб за сугробом.
en: Step by step. Drift by drift.

ru: Иду, куда скажешь. Лишь бы тепло.
en: I'll go where you say. Warm preferred.
I'll reach it. Warm up there.
Well, legs, don't let me down.
Skis would help. Going on foot.
If I freeze, don't wake me.
I'll arrive. Or become a snowdrift.
I'll arrive and drink something hot.

en: Not by the river. Thin ice.

I'm not slow. It's the frost.
Once more and you're chipping ice.
Cold is no reason to get distracted.
Dry and to the point. Listening.

I'm not grim. It's just winter.
I'll smile if I thaw out.
Don't make me laugh. My lips crack.
The collective will warm us. Talk.

My breath is a squad signal.
Move fast. Warm up en route.
I'll warm up on the way.
Blizzard in my face. No fear.
Frost drives me. So I go.

ru: Я туда. Не мёрзните без меня.
en: I'm off. Don't freeze without me.
One step and the drift becomes a trail.
If I fall, it's meant to be.

ru: Идём. Лёд сам себя не проверит.
en: Let's go. Ice won't test itself.

en: I'd go faster. The boots disagree.

Going. No time to warm up.

ru: Приказ принят. По одному не бегать.

en: Good plan. Did anyone read it?

Go on. I'm writing it down.

Let me get on with it!
Once more and I'm writing you up.

ru: Новая задача? Я весь в работе.

If I return, there'll be a tale.

I like you. While you breathe.

Going with a soft cat's walk.
I'll go left. Fewer eyes there.
On my way. Don't delay me.
I'll go ahead. You do you.
Going. No need for a carpet.

en: A step for you. A hello for them.
Off for a stroll. With vials.
My route leads straight to a surprise.
Don't look back. I'm already there.
You'll find out who was knocking.

ru: Тень не твоя? Тогда не трогай.
en: Not your shadow? Leave it alone.

У кого ещё голос из стены?
en: Anyone else hearing the wall talk?

Going. Right foot over the threshold.
Going. The whispers show the way.

I'm here. Keep the flame lit.

ru: Всё в порядке. Они просто смотрят.

ru: Я не боюсь. Я просто бледный.

en: They knock. I politely stay quiet.

Haunted house? More like a shared flat.
I'm used to it. They aren't.
The flame trembles. So they're near.
Going. The candle shows the way.
Going. Don't talk to the void.
Going. The echo won't answer me.
Going. Close the door behind me.
Fine. Just keep the lights on.
Walking. The floor is colder here.
If I vanish, I'll be back.

ru: Шагаю. Пол скрипит. Это не я.
en: Walking. The floor creaks. Not me.

ru: Тихий путь. Тихий я. Тихий ужас.
en: Quiet path. Quiet me. Quiet dread.
Good thing my steps are alive.
Back soon. If they let me.
You'll find out who was knocking.

ru: Тень не твоя? Тогда не трогай.
en: Not your shadow? Leave it alone.

ru: Я пришла. А это со мной.

en: Listening. Let me finish with him.
Me? Or the one behind you?
Fine. Someone was crying there yesterday.
Going. The footsteps behind me are mine.
It's fine. They'll see you out.
Don't fear. There's work there too.

ru: Хватит. У меня ещё три призрака.
en: Enough. Three more ghosts on my list.

ru: Ещё раз — и ночью не уснёшь.
en: Once more and you won't sleep tonight.
One moment. Need to tidy up here.
I hear it. Do you too?
Another stain on the ceiling. Working.

ru: Всё по списку. Осталось три пункта.
en: All by the list. Three items left.
Keep it down. They just fell asleep.
Quiet. I'm talking to the curtain.
Don't be scared. It's a normal Tuesday.

ru: Привидение в доме? Нужен только веник.
en: A ghost in the house? Just need a broom.
Night shift again. I'm used to it.

ru: Меня не напугать. Я видела налоги.
en: Can't scare me. I've seen taxes.
Horrors on schedule. Don't be late.

ru: Если стонет труба — это не я.
en: If a pipe groans, it's not me.
Wait. Let me hear them out.
Going. Don't blow out the candle.
Fine. I'll sweep on the way.
I'll take the edge. Won't step on it.
I'll go now. Don't rush me.
I'll check the room. Need tea.
Going. Darkness is just lights off.
I'll visit them. At least we'll talk.
Off on a call. A supernatural one.
Fine. I'll hold the door for them.
Coming. Find the way as we go.

ru: На карте этой ямы не было.
en: This hole wasn't on the map.

ru: Я туда уже ходил. Не советую.

en: Cover? Lie down. There you go.
Well? What are we rigging up?
Hey. Out in the field again?
Taking a shortcut. I know a trail.
Fine. Over the fence is faster.
Going. We'll fix the tyre later.
Got it, got it. Quit yanking.
Once more and I tie you to the truck.
Talk fast, my hands are full.
Got an idea. Bad, but ours.
Hang on, this bolt won't hold.
I hear you. Just not now.
Go on, tell me what's up.
Got a plan? No? We'll make one.

ru: Мне не нужна карта. Нужна монтировка.
en: Don't need a map. Need a crowbar.
All good. We'll fix it on the knee.

ru: Чего хотел? Я в поле работаю.

en: If it doesn't break, you haven't tried.
Tape and wire. That's the whole science.
No parts? We'll find them next door.
Don't ask how it holds together.

ru: Гайка в кармане. Откуда — не знаю.
en: A nut in my pocket. No idea where from.

ru: Я не ленюсь. Я экономлю силы.
en: I'm not lazy. I'm saving energy.
Going. I'll find a trail somehow.
Going. The ruts will lead me.
Off. We'll see as we go.
Got it. I'll make it on foot.
Going. I'll see what's lying around.
Off. I'll get around the rocks.

ru: Иду. Только не командуй под руку.
en: Going. Just don't boss me around.
Fine, let's go. We'll eat dust.
Going. Big field, plenty of room.
I'll take a shovel. Just in case.
No trails needed. I'll beat one.
Going. If I fall, it's a manoeuvre.
Off. I'll swipe something en route.
If I get lost, we find a new place.
Going. Compass? Well, by the sun.
If I blow up, I warned you.
On foot again. Where's my truck?

ru: Иду. Колея кривая. Как и я.

en: Coming. Find the way as we go.

ru: На карте этой ямы не было.
en: This hole wasn't on the map.

ru: Ветер в спину. Пыль в глаза.
en: Wind at my back. Dust in theirs.
Listening. Sun's in my eyes, talk.
Going. I'll find a way through.

ru: Пройду. Не первый раз в поле.
en: I'll get through. Not my first field.
Here. From all the Rogue Fields.
I know. Not my first day.
Enough. The sun's hot as it is.
Say it straight. No fancy words.
Talk. I'm wiping my eyes meanwhile.
Not my first time. Don't worry.

ru: Тут я. Вода во фляге есть.
en: Here. Got water in my flask.
I see you need me. Speak.

ru: Нож в сапоге, голова на месте.
en: Knife in my boot, head on straight.
I'm used to it. Order calmly.

ru: Дикое поле — не дикое, если знаешь.
en: Wild field isn't wild if you know it.
The field loves the stubborn. So am I.
Don't trip. I won't pick you up.
Who called the lady of the field?
I love the job. You, a bit less.
Going. I'll find a trail by the wind.
Off. I know it all there.
Fine. But I'll cut through the ravine.

ru: Хорошо. Только не наступай на пятки.
en: Fine. Just don't step on my heels.
Off. I'll get around the rocks.
Going. Tell me later how I did.
Going. The wind pushes my back.
Fine. It's close, I'll be quick.

ru: Иду. Траву не топчи лишний раз.

en: I'll go on dry ground. Safer.

ru: Пошла. Где пыль — там и я.
en: Off. Where there's dust, I'm there.

ru: Иду. Тут пройду с закрытыми глазами.
en: Going. I could walk this blindfolded.
A cowboy swagger — free of charge.

ru: Не волнуйся. Я пока ещё ходячая.
en: Don't worry. I can still walk.
If I don't return, I left in style.

ru: Иду. Чужую ногу не отдавлю. Почти.
en: Going. Won't crush anyone's foot. Mostly.
On foot again. Blisters, brace up.

ru: Нет такой тропы, где меня нет.
en: No trail exists where I'm absent.

ru: Не провожай. Я сама себе конвой.
en: Don't see me off. I'm my own escort.
Plenty of us. Save the ammo, though.
Wasn't me. Previous one did it.
They killed me already. Wrong one.

ru: Номер на месте. Имя не обязательно.
Слушаю. Я и ещё сорок таких.
en: Listening. Me and forty more like me.
Ready. Mine was a good batch.
It's me. Definitely me. I checked.
The hive waits. So do I.
Going. The last one got stuck there.
Moving in formation. I am the formation.
Looking for another? We're all like this.
I hear. The answer's ready already.
You can't mix me up. Almost.
The hive hears. I'll pass it on.

ru: Я тот, кто нужен. По расчёту.
en: I'm who you need. By calculation.
Mom? No, I have an incubator.

ru: Нас целая партия. Смешно мне одному.
en: A whole batch of us. Only I laugh.

ru: Не первый. Но и не последний.
Мой брат шутит лучше. Я точнее.
en: My brother's funnier. I'm more precise.
I don't joke. That's a glitch.

ru: У меня сорок лиц. Каждое моё.
en: I've forty faces. Each one mine.
Hard to tell me apart. I try.
Going. I'll see if the last one made it.
Going. All my steps are identical.

ru: Иду. Ритм — один и тот же.

en: Going. If I lag, that's a copy.
Going. The last one disliked it there.

ru: Шагаю. Клонов на тропе нет. Пока.
en: Walking. No clones on the path. Yet.

ru: Иду. Разницы не заметишь. Я тоже.
en: Going. You won't notice. Neither will I.
I go. So does my reflection.
Plenty of us. Save the ammo, though.
I'm next. Don't mix us up.
Good batch. Make use of me.
The hive is watching. Don't shame us.

ru: Сестра бы прошла. Пройду и я.
en: Sister would make it. So will I.
Moving. Don't breathe down my neck.
You're not in the plan. Removing.

ru: Ещё раз — и подам рапорт улью.
en: Once more and I report to the hive.
I'm faster. Keep up the pace.
I'm better than the last. Check.
I'm here. Don't distract my sisters.
Each of us hears the same.
Out of a thousand, you chose me. Logical.
One copy is bad. I'm enough.
We're not twins. We're a batch.
They said I'm a template. I believe it.
No laughter built in. I can imitate.
Don't mix us up. I'm the faster one.

ru: Иду. Следи за мной, если успеешь.
en: Going. Watch me if you can keep up.
Accepted. I'll arrive before my sisters.
Off. The rest follow my trail.
Moving fast. You can't catch me.
Going. No time to look back.
Walking. The hive is proud. Probably.
Off. The other copies can wait.

ru: Бегу. Это не паника. Это график.

en: Moving. Don't blink, you'll miss it.

ru: Иду. Умею и быстрее. Не просили.
en: Going. Can go faster. Wasn't asked.

ru: Иду. Я пока одна. Не навсегда.
en: Going. I'm alone for now. Not forever.
Coming over. Sorry, you'll have to move.
Put the weapon down. Still asking politely.
Yes, I hear you. Thank you.

ru: Вы первые. Я потом по вам.
К вашим услугам. Простите за ожидание.
en: At your service. Sorry for the wait.
Taking position. If you don't mind.
Going. Sorry, stepping on the brass.
I do apologize. This will hurt.
Pardon me, sir. You're in my sights.
If I may, I've got it already.

ru: Ещё раз — и я вежливо обижусь.
en: Once more and I'll be politely offended.
Glad to see you. How may I serve?
The Crown's on the line. So am I.
If I may ask: is that for me?
Sorry, I was thinking about tea.
Ready to serve. The kingdom and you.
Glad to serve. What are your orders?
Most kind of you to call.

ru: Корона ждёт. Но я подожду больше.
en: The Crown waits. But I'll wait longer.
Nothing to thank me for. Yet.
I have the honour. What next?
If need be, I'll die politely.
The Crown would approve. Or not.
The kingdom runs on manners. And bullets.
Don't be afraid. I'm well brought up.
Sorry, I'm a bit tired. Politely.
Command me. I'll try not to offend.
Listening. The Queen would approve my tone.
I know that voice. A pleasure.
Going. I'll send the Crown your regards.
Very well. I'll take the edge.
Going. Walking is an art too.
Fine. I'll try not to make noise.
Heading out. Thanks for your trust.
Following the route. As is proper.

ru: Иду. Шаг мой тих и вежлив.
en: Going. My step is soft and polite.
Setting out. The Crown is proud of me.
Going. If I step on you, I'll apologise.

ru: Иду. Хоть кто-то должен быть вежлив.
en: Going. Somebody has to be polite.
Going. Apologising to everyone at once.
Going. My stride is royal. Nearly.
Going. A bow to the enemy en route.
Going. Bowing to every shell casing.
Going. Let me through, I'm well-bred.
Coming over. Sorry, you'll have to move.
Put the weapon down. Still asking politely.
Yes, I hear you. Thank you.

ru: Вы первые. Я потом по вам.

en: I politely asked you to lie down.
Sorry for the noise. Reloading now.
How can I help? Besides shooting.
Yes, it's me. Lovely to meet you.
The Crown says: hang in there.
I'll take the spot. If it's free.
Thank you. Lovely choice of route.
I asked you three times. Fire.
My patience is ending. Politely, but ending.

ru: Простите, вы не на ту нажали?
en: Sorry, did you click the wrong one?
Speak. I'm well brought up, don't worry.
Glad to help. But no nonsense.

ru: Что угодно? Только не повышайте голос.
en: Yes? Just don't raise your voice.
The Crown is pleased. So am I.
Please, don't be shy. Command me.
Tea after the job, I promise.

ru: Я всегда рядом. Тихо, но твёрдо.

en: Yes, yes, I'm here. All yours.

ru: Без суеты. Но и без промедления.

en: Allow me to clarify the task.
Smile first, shoot after. Taught that.
I kill with kindness. Was taught so.
Sorry, I carry knives. Polite ones.
I was told to be gracious. Trying.
Going. I'll pass your regards to the Crown.
Very well. I'll take the edge.
Fine. I'll try to be quiet.
Heading out. Thanks for your trust.
Setting out. The Crown is proud of me.
Going. A bow to the enemies en route.
No tea, but a confident stride.
Moving out. Who lost the map again?

ru: Ствол убери. Здесь его мало иметь.
en: Gun down. Owning one isn't enough here.

ru: Склад бережём. Людей тоже неплохо бы.
en: Save the depot. People too, preferably.
Here. What is it this time?
Me again? Was there a vote?

ru: На связи. Батарея на двух делениях.
en: On comms. Battery's at two bars.

ru: Ладно, туда. Карту только не теряй.
en: Fine, there. Just don't lose the map.

ru: Иду. Если что — я был против.
en: Going. For the record, I objected.
Skipped your taxes? Pay this way.
Got a target. Got a reason.
Is that a complaint? Write the committee.
You poke like a drill sergeant.

ru: Я в списке? А в бюджете?
en: On the list? In the budget?
I'll get there. Back is TBD.
You know the route? I don't.
I'll walk. On the Republic's dime.
I'll log it. If I find the log.
Moving out. Who lost the map again?

ru: Ствол убери. Здесь его мало иметь.
en: Gun down. Owning one isn't enough here.

ru: Склад бережём. Людей тоже неплохо бы.
en: Save the depot. People too, preferably.

ru: Я на месте. Где обещанная броня?
en: In position. Where's that promised armor?
Made some noise. Their problem now.

ru: Готова. Броню так и не дали.

en: Republic on the line. Well, me.
Copy. I'll grumble on the way.
Are you kidding me? I got it.

ru: Ещё раз — и голосую против тебя.
en: Once more and I vote against you.
Do I get extra for this?

ru: Ты хоть спросил, как я? Нет.
en: Did you ask how I am? No.
Be there soon. Don't miss me.
Going. But I'm taking the coffee.
Off to save the Republic. Again.
Coming closer. Leave the lights off.
Too late to hide. I'm here.
Don't poke. You'll scare them off.
Kill the light. Thanks from everyone.

ru: Я его видел. Больше не вижу.
en: Saw him. Don't see him anymore.

ru: Не ночью страшно. Страшно со мной.
Меня не видно. Так и задумано.
en: Can't see me. That's the point.
Going. They won't hear a step.

ru: Двигаюсь. Не свети мне в спину.
en: Moving. Don't light up my back.
Every click carries to the enemy.

ru: Я был в углу. Теперь тут.
en: Was in the corner. Now here.
The dark is calm. You're not.
Breathe quieter. What do you need?
Easier to see from shadow. What's there?
Listening. Words one at a time.
Switch the light on, I quit.
I don't fear the dark. It fears me.
Shadows get jealous. Don't call loud.
Going along the edge. Darker there.
I'll sneak up. Don't turn around.
Quieter than a step is a shadow.
A dark corner is my friend.
If you lose me, don't search.
Going. The light's on your conscience.
Off I go. Whoever saw, too bad.
If asked in the morning, I wasn't there.
A walk with the lights off.
The shadow goes. It will return.
I'll pass. There'll be no sound.
Coming closer. Leave the lights off.
Too late to hide. I'm here.
Don't poke. You'll scare them off.
Kill the light. Thanks from everyone.
I'm even nicer in the dark.
You can see me? That's bad.
I'll get through. Nobody will notice.
He looks for light. He'll find me.
You click louder than a gunshot.

ru: Ещё раз — и спрячусь от тебя.
en: Once more and I'll hide from you too.
Don't shine in my eyes. Speak.
I'm fine in the dark. Listening.
I listen. So does the dark.
Don't rush. The dark can wait.
No words needed. A rustle is enough.
I'm not hiding. It's just dark.
Just don't turn on the sun.
If it's bright, I'm not here.
Don't call by day. I'm asleep.

ru: Я бы позвала громче. Не умею.

en: I'll get there. The dark helps.
Don't look for me. I'll turn up.
I go first. Keep to the shadow.
They won't notice me. I tried.

ru: Тише. Даже я себя не слышу.
en: Hush. Even I can't hear me.
I put out lamps with a look.
Off I go. You won't see me.
I walk bolder in the dark.
Clear the way. Legion coming through.
Parade later. Get down for now.

ru: Я пришёл. Кто тут не покорился?

en: It'll look glorious in the report.
The Empire salutes you. With lead.
For the glory of the throne!
Your defeat goes in the chronicles.
The legion hears the first time.
Stop tugging. I'm not a trumpeter.
Once more and it's latrine duty.
The Emperor doesn't click like that.
I don't bow. I listen standing.
What say you to the legion?
I hear. The whole legion hears.
I'm loud. So is the Empire.
Say it like the senate. Briefly.

ru: Я готов к триумфу. И к обеду.

en: What a voice! Mine, of course.
Every step is for the Empire.
Order it, I'll reach the edge.
Dust under boot is a reward.
My steps will enter the chronicles.
The Empire's legs are my legs.
I'll conquer this yard. And the next.
Legs hum. So does the Empire.
Going. I won't lower the banner.
Clear the way. Legion coming through.
Parade later. Get down for now.
Emperor hears the version I choose.
I'll take it. Declare it imperial.
Don't flutter about before the legion.
The throne is patient. I'm not.
My step is the Empire's step.
I'll arrive. The Empire will arrive.
Trip, and I'll call it a maneuver.
Going. Laurels on the way back.
Switching it off. Forever, looks like.
Didn't touch it. Just took it apart.
The button will wear out. So will I.

ru: Если дымит — я ни при чём.
en: If it smokes, not my fault.
I'm human, not a device. Though.
Who called the engineer? You. Right.
Schematic in front of me. Speak.
Going. If needed, I'll take it apart.
Going. Don't step on a wire.
Legs are the old version. Going.
Going. Spares rattle in my pockets.
Heading to the field. With tape.
Going. I fix it, I walk it.
Switching it off. Forever, looks like.
Fixed it. Don't switch it on yet.
You look simpler on the diagram.

ru: Это не сбой. Это я злюсь.

en: Clicking again won't speed it up.
I have a hypothesis. Hearing yours.
What to measure? What to test?
Speak to the point. No noise.
Set the parameters. I'll solve it.
If you erred, I've marked it.
I need a graph. Draw one.

ru: Я бы ответила точнее. Дай время.
en: I'd answer more precisely. Give time.
Going. Notes are in my head.
My gait is a subject of study.
Where to? Haven't robbed you yet!

ru: Не тыкай. Меня и так качает.

en: Cargo first. Rescue the others later.
Am I captain or a stevedore?!

ru: Слушаю, капитан. Или кто ты там.
en: Aye, captain. Or whoever you are.
Ready. Saved the rum for later.

ru: Кто будил? Я только на якорь встал.
en: Who woke me? Just dropped anchor.

ru: Иду. Добычу без меня не делить!
en: Going. Don't split the loot without me!
Got it, got it! Stop yelling.
Once more and you're swabbing the deck.
You poke like a seagull pecks.
I'm not drunk. It's the swell.
Honest? I'm a pirate, not a saint.
The parrot spoke louder than you.
Dreamed of a map. You called?
Me the coin, you the glory.

ru: Пират на связи. Шучу, я близко.
en: Pirate on comms. Kidding, I'm near.
Going. Legs on land feel odd.
Going. The compass is in my head.
Going. I rock, and that's fine.
A fair wind is my friend.

ru: Моряк на суше — рыба без воды.
en: A sailor on land: fish out of water.
Where's my ship? Oh, on foot.

ru: Иду. Если что, я не здесь.
en: Going. If asked, I wasn't here.
Walking. Haven't lost the leg yet.
Don't drop the cargo. Be right there.
Where to? Haven't robbed you yet!

ru: Не тыкай. Меня и так качает.

en: Cargo first. Rescue the others later.

ru: Пролив мой. И этот будет мой.
en: The strait's mine. This one will be too.
Holding course. Hands off the helm.
Hand over the cargo. All of it.
Got it. Got it back on shore.
Once more and you pay per click.
I'm not the ship's bell. Stop ringing.
What's the price of the matter?

ru: Если это ловушка — я в доле.
en: If it's a trap, I'm in.
My parrot is worth more than you.

ru: Ты на проценте или на жалованье?
Хриплю от команд. Не от рома.
Ещё не вечер. Ещё не прилив.
en: Not evening yet. Not high tide.
You called, so there's loot to share.
Course is in my head. Going.

ru: Иду. Зачем покупать, если можно взять?
en: Going. Why buy when you can take?

ru: Иду. Если что, я просто гуляю.
en: Going. If asked, I'm just strolling.
If I meet customs, I'll sell it.
Going. The land will owe me.
Off I go. The wind owes me.
Going. You get a share, I the rest.
Moving. Just don't lose the chest.
Coming. Don't tread on my heels.
You can leave. Won't get far.

ru: Я сюда не за советом шёл.

en: Count them when the dust settles.
Wind from the east. Good sign.
I'll get there. I always do.
Moving. Any well on the way?

ru: Беги. Пыль за тобой я вижу.
en: Run. I can see your dust.
The wind will carry you off.

ru: Слышу. Не первый день в пути.
en: I hear. Not my first day on the road.
Patience, friend. Don't rush a caravan.

ru: Ещё раз — и уйду в степь.
en: Once more and I'm off to the steppe.
A roadside stone is more patient.
The steppe is vast. Room enough.
A word to a traveler is a gift.
Quiet night. What do you want?
I left my tea. A sacrifice.

ru: Звал? А я как раз дремал.

en: If it's tea, I'm all yours.
My beard greys while I wait.

ru: Звёзды покажут. Мне и так видно.
en: Stars would show me. I already see.
Don't rush. I'll arrive by sunset.
The horizon won't come to me.
Stone by stone, and I'm there.
My horse is faster; I'm more stubborn.
Coming. Don't tread on my heels.
You can leave. Won't get far.
I know the way. Not this one.
Move. I can walk over you too.
On my way. Don't need a map.
This is where your road ends.

ru: Пыль тебе в глаза. И пуля.
en: Dust in your eyes. And a bullet.
I hear. My ears work fine.
Don't hold me by the reins.

ru: Ещё раз — и ищи меня в степи.
en: Once more and find me in the steppe.
I'm not a mare. Stop prodding.
I'm free, but here for now.
Talk. I haven't changed my mind yet.
The stars are mine. You're a guest.
You called? I almost rode off.
Would answer, but the wind's louder.
Even the horse is more polite.
You spooked the eagle, by the way.
Fine, you called. You must care.
I hear it all, even silence.
No tea. Give me the job.
I'll leave in time. Listen too.

ru: Как жаль, что не позвали раньше.

en: I'd say no. But I'm listening.
The trail will turn up, always.
No hooves needed, I have legs.
Even to the world's edge. Easy.
If I fall, it's a maneuver.
A hundred miles is a warm-up.
The horse is hurt I'm walking.
If I get lost, call it a route.
Don't wait. I've no time to wait.
A long way is my favorite.
I'm going. Don't try to catch me.

ru: Сделаю. Тут дел на два удара.
en: Can do. Two hits should do it.
Don't knock the armor. It rings.

ru: Я целый. Вон тот — не очень.
en: I'm intact. That one, not so much.
Steel doesn't rust. Neither do I.
Who called? Don't scratch the armor.
Taking it. They won't budge me.

ru: Понял. Я не глухой, я в шлеме.
en: Got it. Not deaf, just helmeted.
Knock all you want. I'll just ring.
Metal fatigue. You cause it too.
The forge has cooled. What now?
Make it to the point. No slack.
Ring all you like. I hear.
I'm like a nail. Just smarter.
The sledge asks where to hit.

ru: У меня гудит каска. Это ты?
en: My helmet hums. Is that you?
The weight isn't mine; steel's heavy.
Is that an order, or just knocking?
I rust while I think. Talk.

ru: Рельсы не нужны. Я и так.

en: I'll arrive like bolt to nut.
Oil in my boots, and forward.
If I fall through, floor's weak.
The floor groans. Not my fault.
The echo behind me is me.
Step by step, like a screw.
I'll arrive and fix it all.
Squeak is the motor of the soul.
Not me noisy. It's my joints.
Off I go. Don't bother the steel.

ru: Сделаю. Тут дел на два удара.
en: Can do. Two hits should do it.
Don't knock the armor. It rings.

ru: Не гнусь я. Это так задумано.
en: I'm not bending. It's designed that way.
Who called? My hands are oily.
Taking it. I'll stand like a wall.
I'd walk through a wall too.
Once more and I weld the button down.
What to fix, what to break?
Soldering iron cooling. Bear with me.

ru: Без ключа к людям не лезу.
en: Don't mess with people without a wrench.

ru: Звал? У меня звон в ушах.

en: You called, so I'm needed. Flattered.
Seam's done. Now we can talk.
Even step, like a clean weld.
The shift moves. So do I.
Through, like a cutter through plate.
Walking. It rings, so I'm whole.
Smoke break on the way, okay?
A work pace is the surest.
If I rust, hand me oil.
Going. Make sure the floor holds.

ru: Ключ в кармане, и я иду.
en: Wrench in pocket, and I'm off.
I'll get there. Just don't interfere.

ru: Лист к листу, и я там.
en: Plate on plate, and I'm there.
Marching with an arc in my head.

ru: Ну всё, понесла себя на работу.

en: Poke the enemy. We're on your side.
Share after victory. Equally, got it?

ru: Я за свободу. И за тот ящик.

en: Who dug a trench with slogans again?
Going! I'll sing on the way.
Once more and we elect a new commander.
The barricade was bored. So was I!
Got the slogan. Need an order.
I vote yes! What are we doing?
I wasn't sleeping. I was campaigning.
Task for me again? Best one!
Come on! Even into a hurricane!
Ration in pocket, off I go!
Off. I'll write the resolution later!
Start a song, I'll join in!
I'm not in the way! I'm going!
The flag flutters! So do I!
Poke the enemy. We're on your side.
Share after victory. Equally, got it?

ru: Я пришла за своим. И вашим.
en: Came for what's mine. And yours.

ru: Нового хозяина нам ещё не хватало.
en: Last thing we need is a new master.
Taking it. Declaring it the people's.
Yes! Don't split it without me!
Give up the crate and live. Kidding.
Quit poking. I'm not a rally.
Once more and I go on strike.
With a smile and a pistol.

ru: Я за равенство! Но я первая.

en: Without me it's just a rally.
The voice is mine, opinion shared!
Forgot the slogan. Take my word.

ru: Я тут! И в хорошем настроении!
en: I'm here! And in a good mood!
I'm not a rally, but I'll listen.
Glad you called. I was bored.

ru: Хлопни по плечу, и я там!
en: A clap on the shoulder, and I'm in!
The vanguard's best legs are mine.
If I trip, it's a maneuver!
The flag's in the wind. So am I.
Pick up the pace! Mine, anyway.
Not a step back! Only sideways.
Running before I change my mind.
What a route! I like it!
